questions.question: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-pair that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

Option 1 → 28 : 70 → 28 × 2.5 = 70

Option 2 → 120 : 300 → 120 × 2.5 = 300

**Option 3 → 320 : 480 → 320 × 2.5 = 800, not 480**

Option 4 → 16 : 40 → 16 × 2.5 = 40

All follow the same pattern, except ‘320 : 480’

Hence, “**320 : 480” is different from the rest.**

questions.question: In a class of 45 students, a boy is ranked 20th. When two boys joined, his rank was dropped by one. What is his new rank from the end?
questions.solution:
Given:

Total strength of students = 45

Rank of a boy = 20th from one end.

∴ Rank from another end will be 45 - 20 + 1 = 26th

According to question:

Two boys joined, then total strength now = 47

Then, the rank dropped by one. This means one boy is ahead of him and another one is in behind.

His new rank from the end will be 26th + 1 = 27th

Hence, the rank of the boy is 27th.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d882eb53e1654572ea3dc666dcd3cad190f9f11ae417d152675fc91ed6bf6f2a.png] 

If rank from one side is given, then rank from another side will be:

Total strength - given rank + 1

questions.question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

The administration has set the following criteria for the selection of a teacher in school. The candidate must:

A. Be a graduate with at least 50% marks

B. Have a qualified bachelor's degree in education

C. Not be less than 21 Years and not more than 32 years as on 1st July 2021.

D. For a candidate with Master in Education, the school board may relax the upper age limit.

Rahul Verma is teaching in a reputed school He is 1st class graduate. He was 23 years old when he joined the previous school as a teacher. He has also completed B.Ed.

options.text: The case is to be referred to the school board.
The data given are not sufficient to take a decision.
The candidate is not to be appointed.
The candidate is to be appointed.

questions.solution:
On the basis of the criteria for the selection and the information given about Rahul, the following deductions can be made-

A. Be a graduate with at least 50% marks → Yes, Rahul satisfies this criterion as he is a 1st class (60% or more) graduate.

B. Have a qualified bachelor's degree in education → Yes, Rahul satisfies this criterion since he has also completed B.Ed.

C. Not be less than 21 years and not more than 32 years as on 1st July 2021. → No information about his ***present age*** is provided.

D. For a candidate with Master in Education, the school board may relax the upper age limit. → No information about Rahul's Masters is mentioned anywhere.

 
• As no information about Rahul's age or Masters is provided, so a decision can not be taken.

​Hence, **'option 2' **is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a code language, if ‘FAT’ is coded as ‘81’ then how will ‘HUT’ be coded in the same language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06c01734f8aa4c011a0a36a57e3bea6aebf56189f0aedd590f9d0d65a852ad3.png] 

The pattern followed is,

For FAT,

The place value of F is 6

The place value of A is 1

The place value of T is 20

FAT = (6 + 1 + 20) × 3 = 81

Similarly,

For HUT,

The place value of H is 8

The place value of U is 21

The place value of T is 20

HUT = (8 + 21 + 20) × 3 = 147

Hence, “147” is the correct answer.

All rats are cats

No dog is a cat.

Hence, 'Only conclusions I and III follow' is the correct answer.

questions.question: 15 November 2018 is a Thursday. 15 November 2021 will be a ______.
questions.solution:
15 November 2018 is Thursday

Number of odd days between 15 November 2018 to 15 November 2021 = (odd days in 2019 + odd days in 2020 + odd days in 2021) = 1 + 2 + 1 = 4 days

4 days after Thursday is Monday.

Hence, "Monday" is the correct answer.
